prompt.zh-TW: 風行腳踏車行的損益表標題寫著「某年 1 月 1 日至 12 月 31 日」，資產負債表標題卻只寫「某年 12 月 31 日」。為什麼兩張表的標題不一樣？
prompt.en: Breeze Bicycles' income statement is headed "1 January to 31 December", but its balance sheet is headed only "31 December". Why are the two headings different?

text.zh-TW: 損益表累計一段期間的收入與費用，資產負債表只描述某一天的狀況
text.en: The income statement accumulates a period's revenue and expenses, while the balance sheet describes one day

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。一張像一段影片，一張像一張照片。
feedback.en: That's right. One is like a video of the period, the other like a photograph of one day.

text.zh-TW: 資產負債表的標題漏寫了起始日期
text.en: The balance sheet heading is missing the start date

feedback.zh-TW: 你注意到兩張表的日期寫法不同，觀察得很仔細。不過不是漏寫：資產負債表本來就只有一個日期，因為它列的是那一天擁有多少、欠多少。
feedback.en: You noticed that the two headings are written differently, which is careful reading. But nothing is missing: a balance sheet has only one date because it lists what is owned and owed on that day.

text.zh-TW: 兩張表其實都是描述 12 月 31 日那一天

feedback.zh-TW: 資產負債表確實是描述 12 月 31 日那一天，這一半說對了。但損益表不是：利益不是一天賺出來的，而是一整年累計的結果。
feedback.en: The balance sheet does describe 31 December, so that half is right. But the income statement does not: profit is not earned in one day; it accumulates over the whole year.

explanation.zh-TW: 損益表是「期間」的報表，資產負債表是「時點」的報表，標題就透露了這個差別，所以{{option:o_0h1j}}正確。
explanation.en: The income statement is a period statement and the balance sheet a point-in-time statement; the headings give that difference away, so {{option:o_0h1j}} is right.
